text: いっぱい　なら　つぎに　あった　ときまで　とって　おくね

structure.jp: つぎに　あった　ときまで
structure.en: until the next time we meet
I'll keep it for you, okay

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ておく after a verb says you do it now so it is ready for later. とって おく = 'keep it aside for later'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is the case'. いっぱい なら = 'if you're full'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb in front of とき describes which time is meant. つぎに あった とき = 'the time when we next meet'.
